title: The Renaissance
text: The Renaissance was a fervent period of European cultural, artistic, political, and economic rebirth following the Middle Ages, generally dated to the 14th through 17th centuries. It began in Florence, Italy, drawing inspiration from classical Greek and Roman culture, and spread throughout Europe. Key Renaissance figures include Leonardo da Vinci, Michelangelo, Raphael, Galileo Galilei, and Nicolaus Copernicus. The period saw revolutionary developments in art (perspective, realism), science (heliocentrism), literature (humanism), and philosophy. The invention of the printing press by Johannes Gutenberg around 1440 played a crucial role in disseminating Renaissance ideas across Europe.
